cascadeInspection: Independent review compared the authenticated Header9 MCP anatomy against the complete DOM, scoped CSS, computed geometry, focused tests, and all eight cache-busted captures. One ren-cover owns the 100svh column; one flexing ren-frame media region consumes the remaining top height and clips exactly one cover image; one bottom band contains one ren-center and one ren-switcher with the h1 first and a single ren-stack containing description then a two-link ren-cluster. Primitive Zero margins are neutralized only on direct cover children, heading, and description. At 767px the peers stack in source order; at 768px they become equal-width, top-aligned columns. No bespoke display flex/grid skeleton, duplicate tree, scrim, overlay, navigation, form, logo, video, generated icon, framework leakage, hardcoded color, primitive palette token, or Shadow DOM exists. Both CTA destinations return HTTP 200, remain functional without JavaScript, retain Ren10 focus chrome and 44px targets, and are not clipped by the cover. Light, dark, 320, 390, 767, 768, 1280, reduced-motion, and JavaScript-disabled states show no overflow, overlap, stale-pixel drift, or extra affordance. Captures trace functional commit 8c10f025386f7533c78d5925a8c2919e9da46270; current reviewed commit b89ad08103c9b1857512836308f76ab52019afbd adds only that capture evidence.
